location: Nauvis - Crash Site - Southern Iron Furnace Array
summary: Major milestone today: Wood Processing researched and wood production is finally online. The output rate isn’t impressive yet, but the fact that wood is now automated is a huge step forward.
The current wood setup is clearly insufficient for long-term needs, so scaling it up will be necessary soon.
Our starting copper patch is now down to 135k ore remaining. The throughput low enough that I need to begin planning expansion to the northern copper deposit.

Scaling is the theme right now. After Wood Processing, I’m prioritizing Additional Chunks research to support expansion. Once wood and copper production are both stable and scaled properly, I can finally automate science production properly.
Expanding Additional Chunks means expanding defensive perimeters again. Territory growth equals more walls to defend.

Day attacks are manageable, but night attacks remain brutal. Armored biters and Regenerate biters absorb enormous amounts of ammunition. They don’t deal extreme structural damage, but they completely drain turret magazines.
Nuclear biters and other special variants are the real threat — they continue to punch holes straight through my defenses. I still don’t have a reliable countermeasure for them.

status.resource: Wood production online but under-scaled; starting copper patch at 135k remaining.
status.science: Wood Processing completed; prioritizing Additional Chunks research.
status.defense: Night attacks severe; armored, regenerate, and nuclear biters stressing defenses.
